# truenas_init_shutdown_script (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS init/shutdown script by comment. Init/shutdown scripts have no unique name field; comment serves as the lookup key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `comment` (String) Comment to look up.

### Read-Only

- `command` (String) Shell command to execute (COMMAND type).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this init/shutdown script is enabled to execute.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the init/shutdown script.
- `script` (String) Path to a script to execute (SCRIPT type).
- `timeout` (Number) Time in seconds to wait for the command/script to complete.
- `type` (String) Type of task: COMMAND or SCRIPT.
- `when` (String) When to execute: PREINIT, POSTINIT, or SHUTDOWN.
